summary_md:
# Rabatt på maktbolaget

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-08-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts open on macro risks: US–Canada trade tensions are escalating, long US yields are rising and the Treasury is intervening in the bond market, with Jackson Hole ahead. They then preview three companies reporting this week. Agneta advises caution on Intrum after its huge rights issue and refinancing, Robert makes a small-buy case for Nvidia because its valuation is the lowest since 2019, and Mikael recommends buying Lundbergföretagen at a 14% discount to NAV as defensive, family-controlled exposure.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 LUND-B — Lundbergföretagen | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Mikael's buy case: 14% discount to NAV (19% excluding Industrivärden), diversified and defensive, long-term family control.

#### Reasoning

Guest Mikael Olsson calls this a buy case. The discount is wider than its history, holdings are defensive and diversified, gearing is low and owners think in decades. Industrivärden trades at NAV, so the effective discount is on the other holdings. Funds rotating out of an expensive Investor could add support. Plan to trim if the discount closes.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the discount narrows to around NAV (trim)
- if the valuation of the underlying holdings (Sandvik, serial-acquirer multiples) de-rates

> *"Slutsatsen blir att det just nu är rea på maktbolaget Lundbergsföretagen om man vill ha en bred börsexponering. som drivs av en familj med en defensiv företagarfilosofi så är det ett bra läge nu."*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host Robert reverses his negative view: small buy before the report, 15.7x forward EV/EBIT is the lowest since 2019, H100 rental prices are stable.

#### Reasoning

Robert expects a very strong report, with revenue and profit roughly doubling. AI token prices are falling while H100 rental prices hold, which shows demand for Nvidia chips despite TPU and Chinese-model competition. The stock has only matched the index, so at this multiple little growth is needed. He recommends a small position only.

#### Sell Triggers

- if chip rental prices start falling alongside AI token prices
- if guidance disappoints
- if competition from TPUs and similar chips erodes demand

> *"Så jag tror att man ska våga sig in i med ett litet köp här, rapport på onsdag kväll."*

---

### 🟠 INTRUM — Intrum | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Agneta warns of report volatility and says not to jump in. Carnegie says buy (target 6.60) and P/E is 14 for 2027, 7 for 2028, but past low valuations have not delivered.

#### Reasoning

Agneta Jönsson says the key issues are refinancing (a 7% euro bond replacing an 8% bond, bringing the average rate down from 7.6%), reducing debt of SEK 43-45bn and improving servicing margins toward 30-35% by 2030. New owners (Christian Sveaas ~7%) may add stability. Cheap valuations have failed before, so she advises reading carefully and not jumping in. Mikael sees the turnaround as a chance.

#### Sell Triggers

- if financing costs do not fall
- if servicing margins stall
- if debt reduction falls behind plan

> *"Men läs noga, fundera och kasta dig inte bara in, blir väl rådet."*

---
